items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: Like for example my friend Anthony Wonsey is a jazz pianist.

ctx.x: Would you or any of the guys in your circle ever consider moving there?

I have. I have, yeah. I have friends that are over there that I went to Berklee with, and they have done that and they’re earning a good living too. Like for example my friend Anthony Wonsey is a jazz pianist. He played with Kenny Garrett and he still does the jazz circuit and does all the clubs and stuff. But he lives in Tokyo. And while he’s there he has a kind of like a hotel sort of situation, but he does that and he plays jazz gigs and he teaches there. And I have a few other friends. But not to mention just…
Well did you ever see those old Down Beat where — well they probably still do — they do blindfold tests?
